lines.text: Hello, kya main Kamla Devi ji se baat kar raha hoon?
Main CBI headquarters Delhi se Inspector Rajesh Sharma bol raha hoon.
Aapke Aadhaar card se ek bank account khula hai jismein money laundering hui hai.
Aapke naam par arrest warrant nikla hai, aapko abhi digital arrest kiya ja raha hai.
Video call band mat karna aur kisi ko mat batana, yeh confidential case hai.
Agar aap nirdosh hain toh apna saara paisa RBI ke safe account mein transfer kijiye, verification ke baad wapas mil jayega.
